column1: # A request's id (`rid`, the name of <sub>/requests/<rid> and of its mark objects/<sub>/commands/<rid>): one table for the

# course and the product (each keeps its copy), byte for byte. Owner: «Specification»; the product's conformance — its own acceptance against this table (ADR-0080 addendum 16, ADR-0083); rule: «Architect», 2026-10-06, after the fourteenth review (the course counted characters and answered
# THE RULE: at most 200 BYTES of UTF-8, not empty, not . or ..; no / \ " ' and no character of Unicode's Cc, Zl or Zp
# (controls, U+0085, U+2028, U+2029); not beginning with free- — the family of the resource's own requests
# <sub>/requests/free-<server>-<volume> (M10/8 N1.5, decision of «Architect» 2026-10-18). Refused at the door with a 400; on the worker's path as RequestRefused,
# Columns, tab-separated; a line that begins with '#' and an empty line are no row:
#   rid      the id as a JSON string; a character of Cc, Zl or Zp is written escaped (\u0085, \u2028), every other
